events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: He's brought us some of the most memorable comedy moments in history, from dead parrots to wobbly walks. Today, we're celebrating the one and only John Cleese turning 87. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles', but universally known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles dropped an absolute masterpiece: the 'White Album'. Double album, iconic cover, and tracks that still sound incredible. What's your go-to from it?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We remember the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, the world lost an irreplaceable talent. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. We're celebrating his incredible legacy today on Nation Rocks.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly pushed boundaries and showcased their songwriting genius. Still sounds fresh today, doesn't it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: We remember the iconic musician, songwriter, and peace activist John Lennon, who passed away on this day in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world fell silent as we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. A true legend, never forgotten.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The influential musician and cultural icon, David Bowie, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today, born in 1947.

angles.name: David Bowie Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Today, we're celebrating the extraordinary life and legacy of David Bowie, who would have turned 80. His impact on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today, born in 1935.

angles.name: Elvis Presley Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're honouring the one and only King, Elvis Presley. His music still gets us all shook up!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today, born in 1944.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the guitar god himself, Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his riffs are simply iconic. What's your favourite Page solo?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The gravel-voiced rock legend, Rod Stewart, celebrates his 82nd birthday today, born in 1945.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: He's still got it! Celebrating the 82nd birthday of the one and only Rod Stewart. From Faces to solo superstardom, his hits are timeless. What's your Rod favourite?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today, born in 1961.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: It's the 66th birthday of the Nutty Boy himself, Suggs! The voice of Madness, and still bringing the house down. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The British pop and soul singer, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)", Paul Young, celebrates his 71st birthday today, born in 1956.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! His 80s hits are still absolute classics. What's your go-to Paul Young track?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon, singer, songwriter, and businesswoman, Dolly Parton, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today, born in 1946.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: She's a national treasure and a global superstar! On what would have been her 81st birthday, we're honouring the incredible Dolly Parton. Her songs are pure joy. What's your favourite Dolly hit?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: The lead singer of Take That, songwriter, and television personality, Gary Barlow, celebrates his 56th birthday today, born in 1971.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: The man behind so many hits! Happy 56th birthday to Take That's Gary Barlow. What's your favourite Gary-penned song?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer known for his string of R&B and pop hits in the 70s and 80s, Billy Ocean, celebrates his 77th birthday today, born in 1950.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car'! It's Billy Ocean's 77th birthday today. His tunes are pure sunshine. What's your favourite Billy Ocean classic?

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held, honouring legends like The Beatles, Elvis Presley, and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Rock Hall of Fame Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago today, rock history was made with the very first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who do you think should be inducted next?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member and solo artist, Mark Owen, celebrates his 55th birthday today, born in 1972.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! From the early days to now, he's still got that charm. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop Concert Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert in London. What an iconic way to say goodbye to live performances!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The Grammy Award-winning singer, drummer, and songwriter, Phil Collins, celebrates his 76th birthday today, born in 1951.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! From Genesis to his incredible solo career, his songs are simply unforgettable. What's your favourite Phil track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: The Grammy Award-winning singer, songwriter, actor, and former *NSYNC member, Justin Timberlake, celebrates his 46th birthday today, born in 1981.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake Birthday
angles.copy: He's bringing sexy back! Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake. What's your favourite JT banger?

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The beloved British actor, famous for roles as Del Boy and Detective Jack Frost, Sir David Jason, celebrates his 87th birthday today, born in 1940.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason. What's your favourite role of his?

events.title: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, rock and roll pioneers Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event famously known as "The Day The Music Died".

angles.name: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, we lost three giants of early rock and roll: Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their music lives on, always.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: The English singer, songwriter, and musician, famous for his 80s hit "Never Gonna Give You Up", Rick Astley, celebrates his 61st birthday today, born in 1966.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday
angles.copy: He's never gonna give you up, and we're never gonna give up celebrating him! Happy 61st birthday to the legendary Rick Astley. What's your favourite Rickroll moment?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The reggae superstar and cultural icon, Bob Marley, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today, born in 1945.

angles.name: Bob Marley Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: One love, one heart! Today, we're honouring the incredible legacy of Bob Marley, who would have turned 82. His music and message are truly timeless.
